pages.text: Craft this guide with a book, a copper ingot, and yellow dye in any arrangement.

pages.title: Your First Belt
pages.text: Craft a $(l:satiscraftory:belts/tier_1)Mk.1 belt$(/l). Place a chest with items at the source and another chest at the destination.$(br2)Hold the belt and sneak-right-click a horizontal face of the source chest. This fixes the input face and starts the preview.

pages.title: Connect the Output
pages.text: Sneak-right-click the destination chest face to finish. Items move from the first click toward the second.$(br2)One belt item places one complete section, up to 16 blocks of route length. Longer runs use several connected sections.$(br2)See $(l:satiscraftory:basics/placement)Placement and Routes$(/l).
